text: ‘Globalisation has resulted in greater inequality between countries.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Governments are powerless to prevent the growth of global crime.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘There is no clear evidence that the media influences social behaviour.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Media representations of women reflect gender stereotypes.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Religion serves the interests of the rich and powerful.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘There has been a clear decline in religious belief in all societies.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
